analogy.rationale: HCN channels are voltage-gated cation channels whose blockade in these cell lines is unlikely to engage a strong transcriptional program, so the closest expected responses are other ion-channel blockers with similarly limited transcriptional impact. HCN1-4 are poorly expressed in most of these lines, so the response should be weak.
